# Open PR integration and Kakao release — 2026-10-12

## Request and scope

The user authorized reviewing, repairing, and merging PRs #1837, #1843, and #1848 into dev, testing alpha, creating the dev-to-main promotion PR, and deploying main only after release blockers are cleared. On 2026-10-12 the user recovered the original Kakao account and superseded the new-app migration plan: configure API, web login, Maps, Android and iOS under the original app `1467783`. Preserve its production REST identity and existing account associations. Consent/privacy settings must match actual collection. The user subsequently explicitly authorized both store updates and waived unavailable physical-device testing. Do not expose credentials or rewrite existing consents.

## Ownership

- #1837: Kakao SDK startup timeout, native consent-scope parity, reproducible iOS dependencies, release documentation and configuration wiring.
- #1843: match MSW sport filter contract, final PR description, review and integration verification.
- #1848: reconcile the latest dev room-detail resync with permanent-error filtering; retain both regression contracts.
- Forbidden: unrelated worktree changes, secret values in tracked files or reports, DB resets, rollback, and unverified main promotion.

## Acceptance criteria / exit proof

- [x] Compact business disclosure: the user approved the recommended link treatment before implementation (2026-10-12).
- [x] Login exposes a compact, keyboard-accessible business-information link; its public destination shows the configured full details without authentication. Verify navigation/back behavior and layout at 390/768/1440px on deployed alpha.
- [ ] Email signup keeps direct verification; Kakao-supplied contacts bypass duplicate OTP. Existing verified contact matches attach Kakao to the original user ID; conflicting members never merge.
- [x] A real HTTP/DB integration test proves account/profile preservation and social profile completion with phone verification enforced and no SMS challenge.

- [x] Open review findings are fixed or disproved with concrete evidence; conflicts are resolved without losing existing behavior.
- [x] Each exact PR revision passes the applicable CI checks before dev merge.
- [x] The combined dev revision passes API/Web/Gates and applicable Android/iOS CI; alpha serves that revision.
- [ ] Within each environment, login REST, login JavaScript and native credentials identify its intended app. Maps REST/JS are independently configured and cannot select the login app.
- [ ] Original-app configuration preserves existing user IDs, memberships and history; email-to-Kakao linking uses verified ownership and never infers identity from names or unverified contact data.
- [ ] Console consent items, actual collected fields and public privacy disclosures agree; any review/business-verification blockers are explicit.
- [ ] Console domains, callback URLs, package/bundle identifiers and available signing key hashes match the actual builds.
- [ ] Alpha maps, browser login/session, lists/facets and chat recovery are exercised against deployed code. Native-build proof is distinguished from physical-device KakaoTalk proof.
- [ ] No main promotion while required configuration or authentication validation remains blocked.
- [ ] If gates pass, promote the verified revision, approve the authorized production deployment, verify served SHA/release and affected production flows, and close owned browser/process resources.
